summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for AI data-center power and thermal infrastructure. The reference lane is anchored by Vertiv as an obvious leader in integrated power, cooling, racks, and services. The discovery lane prioritizes less mega-cap-centric suppliers with direct exposure to switchgear, electrical distribution, enclosures, liquid cooling, and data-center thermal systems: Powell Industries, Modine Manufacturing, and nVent Electric. These names require later-layer verification to separate AI data-center demand from broader electrification, industrial construction, and cyclical electrical-equipment demand.
